product_summary: Oswal Pumps Limited (Karnal, Haryana; est. 2003; NSE/BSE listed per own site) is a vertically integrated PUMP MANUFACTURER, not a metals/mining company. Real product lines documented on oswalpumps.com: (1) Solar pumps (MNRE-aligned, PM-KUSUM) with solar pump controllers; (2) Agriculture range — V4–V12 stainless-steel and water-filled borewell submersible pump sets, centrifugal monoblock 1440/2880 RPM, horizontal openwell submersible, thresher motors, squirrel-cage motors; (3) Industrial range — V4–V12 SS borewell sets, vertical & horizontal multistage centrifugal pumps, sewage pumps, SS sewage pumps, mud pumps, squirrel-cage motors 1Φ/3Φ, cooling tower motors, SS centrifugal monoblock, boiler-feed/RO high-pressure pumps; (4) Domestic range; (5) International range (SS fabricated borewell submersibles); (6) Accessories — 3-core flat submersible cable (IS 694:2010) and POLY winding wire. In-house units listed in sitemap: aluminium die-casting, CI/SG casting, cable manufacturing, electrical stamping, automatic winding. Sources: https://www.oswalpumps.com/ (home), /industrial-range.php, /agriculture-range.php, /accessories.php, sitemap.xml.
comment: HS 841381 declared vs actual: PARTIAL. 8413.81 is a legitimate code for the borewell submersible pump sets and solar pump sets, so the declaration is not wrong — but it covers only part of the range. Missing from the declaration: 8413.70 (centrifugal monoblock, openwell, multistage, sewage/mud pumps — a large share of the catalogue), 8501 (electric motors sold as standalone items), 8544 (submersible cable and winding wire), 8537.10 (solar pump controllers). Per project rule 3 no rejection on HS grounds: company retained, code corrected/expanded to the list above; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: claimed 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is wrong — the company is a pump/motor manufacturer (HS ch. 84/85). Casting and stamping units are captive in-house operations, not merchant metallurgy sales. No trader signs found: own manufacturing campus (41,076 sq m, Karnal), own casting/cable/stamping units, ISO 9001:2015, ISI/BEE marks — manufacturer role. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' at the level of customs lines: no customs/B-L record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no HS line is corroborated by a shipment record here. Revenue, export volumes, CIN/PAN and registry data not researched per task scope — null.
